description: This file defines the AutoEscapeTokenParser class, which is responsible for parsing 'autoescape' blocks in Twig templates. It handles the detection of the autoescape tags, processes optional escaping strategies, and constructs corresponding nodes to be rendered.

classes.name: AutoEscapeTokenParser
classes.description: Final class that extends AbstractTokenParser, responsible for parsing 'autoescape' block tags in Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'autoescape' block, determining the escape strategy, and returning an AutoEscapeNode with the parsed content.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines if a token signifies the end of an autoescape block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name that this parser handles, which is 'autoescape'.
